> Key success signals (short list):
> 1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 200ms for 8k context, measured at 99th percentile during canary;

> 5) Cost: inference unit cost projection <= $1.20 per 1M tokens at expected throughput (pre-quantization).

> Exit gates (must all pass to move to full pilot):
> - Integration smoke tests green (auth, request/response schema, tracing hooks);
> - Security questionnaire items 1-12 validated (we'll comment inline on Doc);
> - Performance pass for both latency and concurrency during a 2-hour soak at 50% expected load.
>
> Canary plan (recommended):
> - Day 0: Deploy model variant A to 10% of traffic in Veridian staging;
> - Day 1: Run acceptance harness and A/B quality comparison (metrics in shared Drive);
> - Day 2: Increase to 50% if no rollback triggers; full ramp on Day 3.
